text:
kevin p.: incident-bot triggered PD for private-deploy-east-1. multiple identical alerts coming in quick succession. paging is noisy.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: service=private-deploy-east-1 action=trigger incident_id=PD20098 source=autoscale-latency severity=critical (automated)

alex m.: I'm on call. I see repeated alert signatures flooding PD (same fingerprint). PD shows a dedup delay, looks like alerts re-firing from alertmanager after webhook retries.

tasha r.: our mobile oncall for primary is in DND, and secondary didn't ack — PD escalated to manager. manager pages are going to voicemail.

pagerduty-bot: PD: incident PD20098 escalated to manager (no ack from primary or secondary after 2m) -> sre-lead

sre-lead: i'm awake, joining. can someone paste the quick observability links?

alex m.: graphs: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/private-deploy - spike in queue depth and gRPC errors. logs show gc spikes and worker restarts.

platform-ops: looks like a burst of heavyweight requests hitting an old model variant that wasn't memory-limited. Also nodepool autoscaler hit API rate limit and failed to scale up efficiently.

kevin p.: to reduce noise: can we suppress duplicate PD pages for the same alert.signature for 15m while we triage? want to avoid waking managers repeatedly.

incident-bot: Suggested action: 'suppress-duplicates' can be applied. Will require manual approval from on-call.

alex m.: approving suppression now: command -> apply-suppress --key alert.signature:heavy-mem-spike --duration 15m

incident-bot: Suppression applied. Future duplicate alerts with same signature will be suppressed for 15m.

customer-success: started collecting impacted accounts. approx 7 customers on private cluster reported 5xx errors and stream disconnects. prepping comms.

sre-lead: priority mitigation path: 1) temporarily reroute traffic for affected orgs to dedicated fallback pool, 2) restart a subset of workers with reduced worker_count to avoid OOMs, 3) fix autoscaler rate limit config.

alex m.: routing commands: ```
route override --service private-deploy-east-1 --org-filter "acct: (123,456,789)" --to dedicated-fallback
```

kevin p.: executing restart on canary subset now: ```
kubectl scale deploy worker --replicas=2 -n private-prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/worker -n private-prod --selector=canary=true
```

platform-ops: autoscaler service account had a throttled IAM quota. I'm requesting temporary quota bump and will add exponential backoff.

incident-bot: PD: PD20098 update: suppression active, manager escalation acknowledged by sre-lead.

alex m.: canary restarts successful, error rate on canary tenants down 80%. dedicated-fallback routing successful for two orgs.

kevin p.: upping memory limits on the old model variant to avoid immediate OOMs until we depool and roll. This is a short-term mitigation.

platform-ops: autoscaler quota increased. will monitor scaling behavior.

pagerduty-bot: PD: incident PD20098 secondary acked (alex m.). manager escalation not needed further.

customer-success: posted initial customer note draft in #cs-incidents for review. It says: 'We are investigating intermittent 5xx errors for private-deploy customers in east-1. Temporary reroute initiated; no data loss. ETA 30-45m.'

sre-lead: good. please hold public status until we confirm sustained recovery for 10m.

alex m.: monitoring: queue depth decreasing, p95 latency dropping back, error rate trending down from 6.4% -> 1.1%.

kevin p.: removing suppression after 12m, leaving it active until we confirm no more duplicate flaps.

incident-bot: Reminder: please run post-incident checklist and capture PD escalation timeline.

platform-ops: next steps for postmortem: - make autoscaler idempotent to repeated webhook retries - add PD dedup upstream check to alertmanager - improve runbook for immediate reroute to dedicated pools - test manager paging for DND scenarios

alex m.: filing incident PD20098 in tracker with timelines and actions. tagging stakeholders.

sre-lead: thanks. please schedule postmortem for tomorrow 11am PT. include customer-success and platform-ops.

customer-success: will start outbound customer notifications once PM approves message.

pagerduty-bot: PD: incident PD20098 status=resolved (closed by alex m.)

kevin p.: closing thread. great coordination everyone. sigh of relief. :relieved:

incident-bot: Thread closed.
